XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Fault light comes on, jerking while driving
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0012 | P0016 | KNOCKING | JERKING | RIPPING | TIMING | DISTRIBUTION |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Phase variator

  • Fault: Fault light on, jerking while driving

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0012 - Camshaft in incorrect position (delay)
    P0016 - Crankshaft position

  • Cause: The cause of the fault was a malfunction of the phase variator.

• Action: Proceed with checking and, if necessary, replacing the phase variator

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Before identifying the problem with the phase variator, the distribution was checked and found to be normal.
